newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SOOTS FIRST FINED FOR SHARE ISSUE PROBLEMS.
newsitem.headline: SOOTS FIRST FINED FOR SHARE ISSUE PROBLEMS.

text.p: Catering firm Soots Turism on Monday became the first company to be fined by the securities inspectorate for providing misleading information in its recent public share.
The company was fined 25,000 kroons after it said in its prospectus that its shares were registered with the central depository.
"The data in the issue prospectus was misleading," Jannu Kuusik, a securities inspectorate official, told Reuters.
Kuusik said the inspectorate has never fined a company before but had only made recommendations.
The inspectorate earlier suspended the Soots issue after the prospectus was released.
Soots issued 540,000 new shares at 28 kroons each. The issue, which closed Wednesday, was oversubscribed by 30 times.
